data.long_meaning: Patricia is derived from the Latin word 'patrice' which means 'little, noble one'. In Roman society, the term 'patricius' denoted a member of the hereditary aristocracy, meaning that the name Patricia may have originally been given to a freeborn Roman citizen. The name Patrice carries the meaning “Little, noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Patrice usually hope their child will grow to embody little, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
